quarterly_data.quarter: DigitalOcean press release: DigitalOcean Launches Agent Learning and Data Services for (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: DigitalOcean launched Agent Learning Services - Insights (records every step an agent takes), Signals (flags sessions where the agent stalled, looped, lost the user or failed) and Evaluations and Simulations (tests changes ahead of real users) - available 'today' in public preview (release dated October 12, 2026). The newly enhanced Inference Router optimizer, which picks the best-scoring model for each task optimized for cost, quality or the team's own evaluations, and Agent Data Services, a fully managed data layer for agents (video transcribed, documents indexed, searchable by meaning in a single call, logically isolated per customer), are in private preview. DigitalOcean plans next to bring the same automated loop to agent workflows. Amplitude CEO Spenser Skates: 'DigitalOcean Managed Agents powers Wave', Amplitude's agentic product team.
quarterly_data.figure: Agent Learning Services in public preview; Inference Router optimizer and Agent Data Services in private preview
